title: Whoop Sleep Debt Before High Strain
dataSources: Whoop recovery and strain (`whoop:day`), Garmin ride power (`powermeter:ride`), Stryd runs (`stryd:run`), and gymnastics skill attempts (`gymnastics:skill`).
app: Training telemetry from Whoop, Garmin power meters, Stryd running power, and gymnastics skill trackers maintained in Sheets or app exports sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=whoop:day
| search sleep_debt_min=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(sleep_debt_min) as avg_sleep_debt_min count as days by _time high_strain_day
| sort - _time
description: Tracks sleep debt before high-strain days over time and breaks it out by high-strain flag.
value: This split helps reveal whether the hardest days are being stacked on top of poor sleep.
implementation: Send sleep debt before high-strain days events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of sleep debt before high-strain days by high-strain flag.
grandmaExplanation: It records how sleep debt before high-strain days changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
